description: Historical metric fixture for WO-057: 5 agents, sampled every 30 minutes across 30 days (1440 points/agent) as a representative fixture — the AC calls for 30 days of 5-minute data (8640 points/agent), sampled down here to keep a committed JSON fixture a reasonable size; local dev/CI seeding scripts can upsample by interpolation if finer-grained data is needed.
